findings.explanation: The contract grants the client ownership of derivative works and work product created by you as a work made for hire without conditioning ownership transfer on full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of all derivative works and work product created by the Contractor shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has received full payment, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello! Thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to propose a minor adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement currently assigns ownership of derivative works without tying it to full payment. I suggest updating this section so that ownership transfers only after payment is received, as follows: Ownership of all derivative works and work product created by the Contractor shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has received full payment, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client. Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Best regards,
